correctness.rationale: At a=2/5 the four equal cells have full surviving transitions A→C,D; B→B; C→C; D→A,B, modulo endpoints. Each n-arrow cylinder has length 1/(5·2^n), and M^n1=(n+1,1,1,n+1). The n+2 entry categories (start inside, enter at each k=1,…,n, never enter by n) contain exactly two cylinders each. This proves the survivor and conditional entry laws; normalization by 4/5 and successive differences give P(N=n)=n/2^(n+1), whose mean and variance are 3 and 4. The power series sums to (4−z)/(5(1−z/2)^2); the entry limit follows by Riemann sums. For a≤1/3 the only surviving positive-length branches alternate the two outer intervals, with inverse length ratio 1/2; the isolated equality endpoint has zero mass. Independently enumerated by integer forward iteration on the exact preimage mesh: 13 conditional histograms for a=2/5, n=0–12, and 30 survivor counts at a=1/3, 2/7, 3/11, n=0–9, all agree.
